mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (novel_id, chapter_id, chapter_no, chapter_title, chunk_no, content, embedding, token_count, created_at) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{chapterId}, #{chapterNo}, #{chapterTitle}, #{chunkNo}, #{content}, #{embedding, typeHandler=com.colin.novelanalysis.infrastructure.persistence.handler.PgVectorTypeHandler}, #{tokenCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_id, chapter_no, chapter_title, chunk_no, content, token_count, created_at FROM knowledge_chunk WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} ORDER BY chapter_no, chunk_no
